evidence.source: Independent project implementation following observed reference relationships and Hypit whole/detail/semantic-event principles.
evidence.method: Reference observations and implementation remain separate. Actual local evidence and its limits are recorded in VALIDATION.md; no universal or cross-machine acceptance inferred.

evidence.source: Local queue artifacts, technical quality receipts, actual encoded-frame and isolated-state review, HTTP/UI recovery and the human listening reply.
evidence.method: Specific portrait/landscape v5 outputs and 24 repaired isolated states; source/output hashes and real frame identities remain in private task artifacts. Per-input evidence, not complete continuous viewing or a stable release certification.

structure.note: 115 affected tests passed locally; direct schema check separately recorded. Whole Videohub package still has unrelated historical failures.

technical.note: Specific frozen portrait/landscape v5 films: expected30fps/918frames/30.6s, measured20.494Mbps, complete decode and audio metrics. Does not certify a new input or later renderer snapshot.

visual.note: Sampled scope only:40 encoded frames each aspect; source/target semantic pairs,42 other isolated states plus3 repaired path states;24 repaired core-control states actually viewed. Continuous motion/lip-sync review remains separate.

audio.note: Full same-source Hou narration and measured mix preserved. Human confirmed three named films clear with audible non-masking music; exact Quest revision/device unspecified. Model hearing and additional landscape listening are not established.

platform.note: Not yet verified for this new template.

user_review.note: User explicitly approved portrait v7 as the final template look on2026-11-01; approved-look-v1.json binds its exact output SHA and seven-scene recipe. No approval inferred for all fifteen controls, new voices, landscape evidence windows or another machine.

production.note: Specific local UI/CLI→frozen draft→unified queue→actual artifacts and work entries, ordinary startup and exact completed-job recovery verified. No publication, cross-machine or complete stable-release certification.

custom.rules: Fifteen implemented controls; tested scope is separate in VALIDATION.md. Local cues are explicit increasing frames, label counts/minimum durations from layout.json. Path cues reference stops, not all nodes; stable graph identity carries position across adjacent scenes, reset is explicit, skipped nodes stay incomplete. Rank permutations preserve all original IDs; strikes follow ID; order basis required. Comment proof follows complete typed question and retains last-photo reading. 12-frame checker/iris is below presenter20 and captions40. 15-frame entry/10-frame exit,18-frame presenter morph. HP/scan/editor are labeled illustration, never measured statistics. No fabricated word timings.

avatar.face_crop: contain; video content retains original proportions in card/circle mask; per-film review required.
avatar.synchronization: Global clip.from and source offset; actual source length checked. Source persists through scene changes. A partial performance is shown only in its original matching narration interval.

graphic.text_policy: Font metrics reject overflowing titles, captions and labels; full speech stays in measured captions.
graphic.asset_fit: contain original media; embedded captions/logos in footage remain non-editable.

material_edit.source_ranges: Reviewed original source offsets; scene plays at1x, source audio muted.
material_edit.cut_policy: Contiguous scenes cover full narration plus allowed tail; no media loop/freeze fallback.
